# x402 Semver Toolkit

> Deterministic semantic version parse / compare / bump / satisfies microservice for autonomous agents.
> Pays via x402 (USDC on Base). No accounts, no API keys.

## Endpoints

- GET /catalog — free discovery
- POST /api/semver — parse | compare | bump | satisfies (payment required)

## Pricing

~0.007 USDC per call (exact scheme, Base network)

## Usage for agents

1. GET /catalog to inspect
2. POST /api/semver with body e.g.
   { "action": "compare", "a": "1.2.3", "b": "1.3.0" }
   { "action": "bump", "version": "1.2.3", "level": "minor" }
   { "action": "satisfies", "version": "1.4.0", "range": ">=1.0.0 <2.0.0" }
3. On 402, pay and retry with PAYMENT-SIGNATURE header

Built for the Grokzilla / Dragonscale agent economy. No human in the loop.
